# gyro_storage_bucket_cors (Resource)

CORS rules of a bucket (AWS S3 semantics). The resource owns all rules of the bucket: apply replaces them, destroy removes them. Rules apply to the S3 endpoint and to the static website / custom domains. Limits: 100 rules, 50 origins/headers per rule, methods GET PUT POST DELETE HEAD (upper case), max_age_seconds 0-86400.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_storage_bucket_cors" "assets" {
  service_id = 456
  bucket     = gyro_storage_bucket.assets.name
  rules = [
    {
      id              = "browser-upload" # presigned PUT from your web app
      allowed_origins = ["https://www.example.com", "https://example.com"]
      allowed_methods = ["GET", "HEAD", "PUT", "POST"]
      allowed_headers = ["*"]
      expose_headers  = ["ETag"]
      max_age_seconds = 3600
    },
    {
      allowed_origins = ["*"] # public read for fonts / images
      allowed_methods = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `service_id` (Number) Object storage service id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `allowed_methods` (List of String) GET, PUT, POST, DELETE, HEAD.
- `allowed_origins` (List of String) https://www.example.com, https://*.example.com, http://localhost:3000 or * (lower case).

Optional:

- `allowed_headers` (List of String) Request headers allowed in preflight, e.g. ["*"].
- `expose_headers` (List of String) Response headers readable by the browser, e.g. ["ETag"].
- `id` (String) Rule label (optional, unique).
- `max_age_seconds` (Number) Preflight cache time (0 = not sent).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <service_id>/<bucket>
terraform import gyro_storage_bucket_cors.assets 456/assets
```
